meta.layout: states are [past_1..past_n, future_1..future_n]; atom_order entries are (past antichain, future antichain) with 1-based variable indices; atoms/pointwise values are in atom_order; pointwise row k <-> states[k]; atom_names (n = 2 only) are the phyid-style names, past letter + 't' + future letter, r = {1}{2}, x = {1}, y = {2}, s = {12}
meta.series_lagging: series cases use samples (x_t, y_t, x_{t+tau}, y_{t+tau}) for t = 1..N-tau (1-based); discrete_series states/weights are the distinct lagged states (lexicographically sorted) and their counts
meta.gaussian: syntropy.gaussian.decompositions.integrated_information_decomposition(inputs=(0,1), target=(2,3), data=4 x (N-tau) lagged matrix, cov=None, redundancy_function='mmi'); covariance = np.cov(data, ddof=0) (mean-centred, divided by N-tau); MI = 0.5*(logdet + logdet - logdet) via slogdet in nats; values here are divided by ln 2 to give bits
